messages.subject: Old questions on codewake
parts:
Before opening this google-group, I used codewake as a platform to ask questions about brms for several months.
The brms codewake page can be found at

https://www.codewake.com/p/brms

Since I wasn't particularly happy with the features codewake offered, I now recommend using only this google-group (or github)
for discussions and questions about brms.
